verdict.rationale: The only evidence touching SDKs is Adyen's claim that it supports online payments on web, iOS, Android, React Native, and Flutter. That implies official client-side libraries, but the pack never names an SDK, its packages, or its docs. The OpenAPI spec repo is offered only as a way to generate your own client libraries, which is a developer building block rather than an official SDK, so it earns no credit. missing for 10: explicit official SDK documentation (named packages and install instructions), server-side SDKs for major languages, versioning and maintenance evidence, AI-native usage guidance for the SDKs, and independent hands-on corroboration.
